# dsh-standardcompute

A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that adds
Standard Compute as a model provider.

Standard Compute is an OpenAI-compatible API (`https://api.stdcmpt.com/v1`) with one key for
many mo

dels. Its `standardcompute` model is a router: for each request it picks a model and
provider, sendi

ng routine steps to cheaper models and harder ones to stronger models. You can also
pin one exact mo

steps to cheaper models and harder ones to stronger models. You can also
pin one exact model by id.

This package is configuration only. Requests go through dsh's own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`
adapt

er; the bundle adds one route to it. There is no code that runs on your machine besides
dsh itself.
## What you get
A provider route named `standardcompute` with three models in the picker:
| Model id | What it is |

| `standardcompute` | The router. Picks the model per request. Text and images. |
| `deepseek/deepse

ek-v4-pro` | Pinned DeepSeek V4 Pro. Text. |
| `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` | Pinned Claude Sonnet
5.5. Text and images. |

Any other id from `GET https://api.stdcmpt.com/v1/models` works too: add it on
**Settings → Models**

(edit the Standard Compute provider, **Fetch available models**) or in your
profile's `cordis.patch

the Standard Compute provider, **Fetch available models**) or in your
profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.

## How the router works

You send `model: "standardcompute"`. The gateway looks at the request and picks a model and an
upstr

eam provider for it; routine steps go to cheaper models and harder steps to stronger ones. A
pinned

id such as `anthropic/claude-sonnet-5.5` skips that choice and always uses that model.
Images are ac
cepted on the router; it chooses a vision-capable model when a request carries one.

Reasoning: this bundle declares no reasoning levels, so dsh sends none and the reasoning setting
on

your Standard Compute dashboard applies. If you want dsh's **Effort** menu instead, declare the
leve

## Billing: requests stop at the budget

Standard Compute is a monthly plan with a fixed compute budget, not pay-per-token. When the
plan's b

udget is used up, new requests fail with **HTTP 402** until the plan renews or you change
plans. Req

uests already running finish, and nothing is billed on top of the plan. In dsh a 402
shows up as a f

ailed request on the `standardcompute` route; switch to another provider in the
model menu if you ne
ed to keep going. Plans and budgets: standardcompute.com.
## Already have other providers?

A Cordis patch replaces a row's whole `config`, and your profile's own `cordis.patch.yml` is
applied

after plugin bundles. So if that file already configures `llm-pi-ai` (for example because
you added

a provider by hand before installing this plugin), your file wins and the
`standardcompute` route d
oes not appear. Two ways to fix it:

- Paste the `standardcompute:` block from this package's `cordis.patch.yml`
under `providers:` in yo

ur profile's `llm-pi-ai` entry, or
- add it by hand on **Settings → Models → Add model provider → Cu

stom model API**: Provider ID
`standardcompute`, base URL `https://api.stdcmpt.com/v1`, protocol **O

penAI Chat Completions**,
model `standardcompute`.

Adding providers on the Models page after installing this plugin is fine: dsh's config editor
writes
the complete current provider list, `standardcompute` included, into your profile.
## Configuration written by this plugin
[代码示例省略，未执行]
`apiKeyEnv` is a credential reference, not a key. Nothing secret is stored in this package.
## Troubleshooting
- **`MISSING_CREDENTIAL`**: no key found. Save it on Settings → Models or export `STANDARDCOMPUTE_AP

I_KEY`.
- **`AUTH: 401 Invalid API key`**: the key is wrong or revoked. Create a new one on the dash

board.
- **HTTP 402**: the plan's compute budget is used up for this period. See "Billing" above.
-
**The route is missing after install**: see "Already have other providers?".
